later_relationship_results: not examined; reserved for a later human-directed replication
context_donor_policy: conservative; identical donor source under both response policies
context_leave_out: exclude focal stock for profiles; both focal stocks for pairs
common_reaction_control: subtract current donor median reaction, excluding focal stock or pair; unit-loading de-medianing, not a fitted model
pair_correlation: Pearson on the same contemporaneous response quantity in ordinary and decline states; signed-return correlation reported separately

candidate_screen.ranking_if_any: minimum across policies of decline-minus-ordinary adjusted correlation
candidate_screen.if_none: report none; do not relax the screen

example_uncertainty: 1000 resamples of whole decline episodes plus leave-one-episode-out ranges; descriptive post-selection intervals, not corrected significance
interpretation_order: lead interprets evidence before AI conclusions
authorship: human supplied hypothesis/context; AI supplied disclosed operational definitions and implementation; no inference that every parameter was chosen by the lead
